introEn: Use athlete fitnessLevel, workoutDuration, pushups/squats/pullups baselines, and benchMax/deadliftMax (when provided) to set sets, reps, and restSec per exercise — not generic 3×10 for everyone.
introAr: استخدم مستوى اللياقة ومدة الجلسة واختبارات الضغط/السكوات/العقلة وأقصى بنش/ديدليفت (إن وُجد) لتحديد المجموعات والتكرار والراحة — وليس 3×10 للجميع.

durationAdjustments.30: Cap at 3 exercises; 2–3 sets; compound-first; restSec 60–75 on accessories.
durationAdjustments.60: Full volume; 4–5 exercises; room for 1 accessory block.
durationAdjustments.90: Higher end of sets/reps ranges; optional finisher set on last exercise.

baselineOverrides.pushups_lt12: Upper push: machine/cable or incline; reps 12–15; avoid heavy barbell bench until baseline improves.
baselineOverrides.pushups_gt20: Allow standard barbell/dumbbell pressing; reps 8–12 on compounds.
baselineOverrides.squats_lt12: Legs: leg press, goblet squat, split squat; reps 12–15.
baselineOverrides.squats_gt20: Allow barbell squat pattern; reps 8–12 on compounds.
baselineOverrides.pullups_0: Pull: lat pulldown, assisted pull-up; reps 10–15.

compoundVsAccessory.compound: First 2 exercises: use lower rep end of range (6–10 advanced, 8–12 intermediate, 10–12 beginner).
compoundVsAccessory.accessory: Last 1–2 exercises: +2 reps vs compounds; restSec −15s; 2–3 sets.

maxLiftNoteEn: When benchMax/deadliftMax exist in dossier, program rep ranges the athlete can hit at ~70–80% estimated 1RM — dashboard will suggest first-set load.
maxLiftNoteAr: عند وجود benchMax/deadliftMax، برمج نطاق تكرار يُنفّذ عند ~70–80% من 1RM — لوحة التحكم ستقترح وزن أول مجموعة.
